name: wovenflow-bench
description: Bench harness for the DTDD prompting-style comparison. See doc/specs/2026-05-10-dtdd-bench.spec.md for the contract.

scripts.pretest: node ../plugins/wovenflow/skills/testflow/extract.mjs ../doc/specs/2026-05-10-dtdd-bench.spec.md out/spec-tests/ --lang javascript && { [ "$(ls -A out/spec-tests/ 2>/dev/null)" ] || { echo 'extractor produced no files'; exit 1; }; } && for f in out/spec-tests/*.test.js; do node scripts/dedupe-imports.mjs "$f"; done && node scripts/setup-fixtures.mjs
